edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “Francis Halzen wins the Nobel Prize in physics for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and his discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.”; on the same day, UPI reported “A Belgian-American physics professor at the University of Wisconsin won the Nobel Prize in physics Tuesday for his work in studying neutrinos at his brain-child facility in Antarctica.”.

On 2026-10-06, NPR reported “Born in Belgium, the 82-year-old scientist is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the U.S.”; on the same day, UPI reported “Dr. Francis Halzen, 82, was traveling in Italy when he answered a call from Sweden telling him that he had won the prize "for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin."”.

On 2026-10-06, The Wall Street Journal reported “Halzen, who is 82-years-old and based at the University of Wisconsin-Madison”; on the same day, NPR reported “Born in Belgium, the 82-year-old scientist is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the U.S.”.

On 2026-10-06, The Wall Street Journal reported “Halzen, who is 82-years-old and based at the University of Wisconsin-Madison”; on the same day, UPI reported “Dr. Francis Halzen, 82, was traveling in Italy when he answered a call from Sweden telling him that he had won the prize "for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin."”.

On 2026-10-06, The Wall Street Journal reported “Halzen will receive the 12 million Swedish kronor”; on the same day, NPR reported “The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), whether for an individual, a small group of laureates or an organization.”.
